# the aphes.ist design system: not part of parataxis's licence

The files in this folder are aphesist's: the aphes.ist design system's lab kit, from the
[aphesis](https://github.com/aphesist/aphesis) repository, `design-system` branch. Their owner uses them on
parataxis's own page. They are **not** covered by parataxis's licence, and a fork may not use them to present itself.

Nothing on the page loads anything from aphes.ist at run time: every file is here, pinned.

| file | what | terms |
|---|---|---|
| `lab-kit-v1/` | the lab kit 1.1.0: `lab.css`, `lab.js` and `fonts/`: Aphesis Script (SIL OFL 1.1, Reserved Font Name "Aphesis Script") and Special Elite (Apache 2.0, © 2010 Astigmatic) | the owner's; the fonts under their own licences |

The φ, the project icons and the wordmarks set in Aphesis Script are trademarks of aphesist and are not licensed by
the OFL or by any project's licence.
